candidate.title: Hand-written version data
candidate.rejectionReason: Writing descriptors by hand cannot detect drift: there is nothing to compare a hand-written file against except the jar it was meant to describe, which is the generation this gate is choosing between. It also does not survive the hook inventory growing past a page.
